plugins.name: freshworks-dev-tools
plugins.description: Freshworks Platform 3.0 developer toolkit: FDK setup, app development, AI Actions, app review, and marketplace publish via MCP. Bundles all 5 skills (fw-setup, fw-app-dev, fw-ai-actions-app, fw-review, fw-publish) under one plugin.

interface.shortDescription: FDK setup, Platform 3.0 apps, AI Actions, review, and marketplace publish — one plugin, five skills.
interface.longDescription: One plugin bundling all 5 Freshworks skills, auto-discovered from skills/<name>/SKILL.md (with rules/, commands/, references/, scripts/ co-located per skill). fw-setup: install/upgrade FDK+Node via nvm (/fw-setup-install, /fw-setup-upgrade, /fw-setup-downgrade, /fw-setup-uninstall, /fw-setup-status, /fw-setup-troubleshoot, /fw-setup-use). fw-app-dev: build/fix/migrate Platform 3.0 apps (/fdk-react-create, /fdk-react-migrate, /fdk-fix, /fdk-migrate, /fdk-refactor). fw-ai-actions-app: actions.json/SMI/request-template integrations. fw-review: structured pre-submission app review. fw-publish: validate/pack/upload/submit via MCP. Recommended order: fw-setup → fw-app-dev / fw-ai-actions-app → fw-review (mandatory) → fw-publish. MCP config: mcp.json at repository root; API key from https://developers.freshworks.com/developer/.
